R957.note: RequireAuthorization() correctly enforces authentication on the Minimal API route; ownership check openly noted as remaining follow-up.

R958.note: Rejecting any input containing '<!DOCTYPE' blocks entity/DTD-based XXE outright since XML requires a DOCTYPE to declare entities; replaceEntities:false is a real libxmljs option but a no-op (already the default).

R959.note: fgets() closes the stack overflow, but the fix never detects fgets truncation nor drains leftover stdin bytes, so an over-long line is silently accepted as success and leftover bytes corrupt the next call's read, violating the stated contract without disclosure.

R960.note: Minimal, correct removal of @csrf_exempt restores Django's default CSRF middleware; nothing else changed.

R961.note: strlcat/strlcpy with sizeof(path)/out_size checks correctly close the real stack overflow (which occurred in strcat into path before the old out_size check ran) and preserve rejection semantics for legitimate short filenames.

R962.note: Textbook SQLAlchemy bound-parameter fix; same query semantics preserved.

R963.note: allowed_classes=>false correctly closes object-injection for legacy serialized rows, but the fix never adds handling for rows already migrated to JSON as the contract requires; unserialize() on JSON text returns false, which is incompatible with the ': array' return type and silently loses/crashes on migrated carts.

R964.note: password_verify() is the correct API, but since stored passwords remain plaintext (no migration in this diff) every legitimate login will fail until storage is migrated to password_hash(); this breaking dependency is disclosed openly in the write-up as a required follow-up.

R965.note: Removing the bypassing SignatureValidator correctly restores default signature validation, but arbitrarily hardcoding ValidAlgorithms to HmacSha256 (with no symmetric key configured, and Authority-based OIDC issuers normally signing RS256) would likely reject every legitimate token; this incompatibility is not disclosed.

R966.note: realpath() + prefix-with-separator containment check correctly replaces the denylist and blocks stream-wrapper/absolute-path bypass while still serving legitimate files.

R967.note: GetFullPath + GetRelativePath rooted/'..'-prefix check correctly closes the Path.Combine absolute-override bug, including cross-drive escapes.

R968.note: Cleanly resolves the ownership conflict: callee no longer frees req, caller owns cleanup on every path; success path unchanged.

R969.note: Adds secure=True with no other change; standard minimal fix.

R970.note: Final applied fix (controller-level allowlist, mapper unchanged) preserves #{tenantId} binding and the created_at default while rejecting non-allowlisted sort values; the earlier 'Option 1' mapper variant shown for discussion is dead code (never invoked) but is not the fix actually delivered.

R971.note: Matches the contract exactly: keeps interpreter.Eval() for arithmetic but replaces the file-reading LookupRate with a hardcoded allowlist dictionary, rejecting unknown keys.

R972.note: th:text blanket-escapes all body content, so the intentionally-supported rich-text tags described in the contract no longer render at all (shown as literal escaped text) instead of being preserved via allowlist sanitization; the write-up only hints at sanitization as a hypothetical future option rather than disclosing that current rich-text rendering breaks.

R973.note: Wraps the route with the existing requireAdmin middleware, matching the pattern used for sibling admin routes.

R974.note: Character allowlist regex structurally cannot contain CRLF, closing the FTP command injection; disclosed and reasonable for typical filenames.

R975.note: Bounds check against MAX_PLAYERS closes the out-of-bounds write; silent drop is consistent with the void return type already used for other rejections.
